name: Hiiragi Mao
source: Mio's twin sister. Mao is just as pretty as Mio but is much more light-hearted. Unlike Mio, Mao is very sensitive and cries easily. Ryo treats her as if she was his sister, but it seems like there is something she is unhappy with...
